Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF
2001
CIVIL SERVANTS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 4th August, 2001]
F.No.2(1)12001-Pub., dated
4-8-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Civil Servants
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 13, Act LXXI of 1973

2. Amendment of section
13, Act LXXI of 1973.--In the Civil Servants Act, 1973.(LXXI of 1973), in
section 13, in subsection (1), in clause (i), for the word
"twenty-five" the word "twenty" shall be substituted.
